videos.script: Lesson 3 trained a model on a column from today's table, and it scored point nine nine four. Lesson 5 fed a model features from somebody else's code, and a hundred and sixty probabilities moved. {{two}} Both were the same mistake. A feature computed in more than one place, or at the wrong moment. {{same}} A feature store is the place a feature is computed once, kept with the day it was true, and handed to anyone who asks. {{store}} Training asks it what a member looked like on a past day. {{offline}} A service asks it what the member looks like now. {{online}} This lesson builds one, small, on SQLite. Thirty-nine weekly snapshots, a join that never reads past its own moment, and a table a service can read in a fraction of a millisecond. {{build}} Then the test that matters. Training rows from the store are identical to the ones features dot py builds. And a shortcut, joining the latest values instead, drops the model from point seven nine to point six four. {{test}} Last, what a real feature store adds, and when you do not need one at all. {{end}}
